default/32072.htm.text: Edwin: You! Stop right there! Pant, pant... Oh, this is too hard on me... Young man, please! Catch those guys for me! Those guys hid my underwear that I brought out to wash and now they're running away! That wicked, wicked Adolph! He's the worst troublemaker... I must catch him and punish him!
